title: Fallen Survey Line
description: A surviving foot and three split shaft drums along one fall line, ending in a broken cushion capital.

review.notes: Round 3 (final). Fixed: the drums now lie on their sides, and a column base with torus is present. Still failing: the drums have a stair-stepped, terraced profile, so two of them read as stepped blocks rather than fluted cylinders (closeup_upper, closeup_base); the break faces are smooth, flat cuts; the pieces still sit in one row across the frame instead of along a fall line, and they rest on the turf instead of sinking into it; the stone is clean white with grey smudges. Fix: true cylindrical drums with concave Doric flutes and sharp arrises, rough fracture faces with chips, a fall-line layout with drums partly sunk into the turf, and local grime and lichen.
